nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bạn bè · bài tự soạn
title: Group chat · Linh's birthday
L: Mai: Hey guys! Linh turns twenty on Sunday, so let's throw her a surprise picnic.
Tuan: Count me in! I can bring some snacks and a speaker.
Mai: Awesome. Can someone get the cake? I'm kinda busy on Saturday.
Hana: I'll do it. Chocolate, right? She's crazy about chocolate.
Tuan: Just don't tell her anything, okay? It's a surprise.
Mai: Got it. Let's meet at the park gate at ten.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 1: Linh turns twenty on Sunday, so let's ___ her a surprise picnic.
exq.why: throw sb a party / picnic = tổ chức tiệc cho ai; do / put / hold không dùng theo kiểu "___ her a picnic".

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: Count me ___! I can bring some snacks and a speaker.
exq.why: Count me in = tính cả tớ; câu sau "I can bring…" cho biết Tuan tham gia.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: Chocolate, right? She's crazy ___ chocolate.
exq.why: be crazy about sth = mê cái gì.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 4: ___. Let's meet at the park gate at ten.
exq.why: Got it = Rõ rồi (đã hiểu), câu đáp ngắn khi nhắn tin.
Hana: “I'll do it.” sau câu hỏi ai lấy bánh.
